scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Hello {0}, do
you want to buy some items?
You'll have to give me Love
Flowers for them, of course!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮娅]^000000
你好，{0}！想买点东西吗？
当然，要用爱心花来交换！

scripts.text: Yes, sure!
scripts.translation: 当然要

scripts.text: No, never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Select an item.
The amount of Love Flowers you'll need is in brackets.
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮娅]^000000
请选择物品。
括号内的数字是所需的爱心花数量。

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Are you sure you want to trade ^00aa00{0}x Love Flower ^000000 for ^0055FF{1}^000000?

^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
You'll need more Love Flowers if you want that!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮娅]^000000
想要那个的话，你需要更多爱心花！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Are you sure you want to trade ^00aa00{0}x Love Flower ^000000 for ^0055FF{1}^000000?
Have fun with your item!
No, I've changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 改变主意了

scripts.text: Yes, trade!
scripts.translation: 确认交换

scripts.text: Have fun with your item!
scripts.translation: 祝你用得开心！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Thank you so much for
getting our Flowers back!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮娅]^000000
非常感谢你把我们的花带回来！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
You have to bring me 15 Love Flowers!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮娅]^000000
你得给我15朵爱心花！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Take this as a little
'thank you'.
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮娅]^000000
拿这个当作一点谢礼吧。

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
If you get more Love
Flowers, you can exchange
them for some sweets here.
See you soon!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮娅]^000000
如果你收集到更多爱心花，可以来这里交换甜点。
下次见！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Please bring a +8 Cake Hat
to the Baker Extraordinaire
standing next to me!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮娅]^000000
请把一顶+8蛋糕帽交给我旁边的非凡面包师！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Hello {0}, it's
Valentine's Day and we
love to deliver sweet
chocolates.
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮娅]^000000
你好，{0}！今天是情人节，我们想为大家送上甜甜的巧克力。

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Our problem is that we
need a strong person
like you who could help
us, but first you'll have
to bring a +8 Cake Hat
to the Baker Extraordinaire, who
is standing right next to me!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮娅]^000000
我们需要像你这样强大的人来帮忙。不过，首先请把一顶+8蛋糕帽交给我旁边的非凡面包师！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Hello {0}!

^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
Exchange your Love Flowers with Pinkamenia!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[非凡面包师]^000000
拿爱心花去找平卡梅妮娅兑换吧！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
Bring 15 Love Flowers to Pinkamenia!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[非凡面包师]^000000
带15朵爱心花给平卡梅妮娅！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
Ah, so Pinkamenia told you
to bring me the +8 Cake
Hat. Now I'm going
to exchange your +8 Cake
Hat for another Cake Hat.
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[非凡面包师]^000000
啊，平卡梅妮娅让你把+8蛋糕帽带来。现在我会用另一顶蛋糕帽换下你的+8蛋糕帽。

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
Sorry, but where is your
+8 Cake Hat? Bring
it to me, and remember
to have it equipped!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[非凡面包师]^000000
不好意思，你的+8蛋糕帽呢？把它带来，记得先装备上！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
Now, if you wear the
new Cake Hat, there
is a chance that
Demi-Human Monsters will
drop a Love Flower!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[非凡面包师]^000000
戴上新的蛋糕帽后，击败人形魔物时有机会获得爱心花！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
The mobs stole our Flowers,
which we need to create 
our chocolates. Now get
15 Love Flowers and bring
them to Pinkamenia!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[非凡面包师]^000000
魔物偷走了制作巧克力所需的花。收集15朵爱心花，交给平卡梅妮娅吧！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
Hello, {0}!
